card.name: Inside tartrate and tartrazine names
card.fires_on: The piece 'tr' inside 'Tartrate' or 'Tartrazine' after 'Tar', mainly in opioid drug names like levorphanol tartrate and in FD&C Yellow No. 5 warnings. Weaker hits on a few other medical words such as 'stimulatory'.

modes.label: Tartrate salt names
modes.description: The 'tr' piece in 'Tar-tr-ate' after an opioid drug name.

modes.label: Tartrazine dye
modes.description: The 'tr' piece in 'Tar-tr-azine' in FD&C Yellow No. 5 warnings.
modes.example: 5.10 FD&C Yellow No. 5 (Tar<<tr>>azine) This product contains FD&C Yellow

modes.label: Other scattered words
modes.description: Occasional hits on single words like 'ulatory' in 'stimulatory' or 'incidence'.
modes.example: The stim<<ulatory>> effects of amphetamines may be inhibited

card.writes: The promoted tokens relate to electromagnetic and magnetic physics, which does not fit the drug-name pattern, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of the words tartrate and tartrazine in drug labels.
